title: ManagedPolicy
description: A managed policy document (FR-106, docs/12 §10, ADR-078, ADR-097 D4): the OS-protected local file managed-settings.json (Linux /etc/nova/, macOS /Library/Application Support/Nova/, Windows %ProgramData%\Nova\), or the policy inside a signed remote envelope ($defs/remoteEnvelope). settings become the locked managed settings layer; restrict narrows what Nova may do. Managed policy only tightens: a value looser than the user's or the default is ignored and reported. A document from a trusted source that fails this schema fails closed (every agent tool is denied). At most 1 MB. Mirrors managedPolicySchema in packages/shared/src/m8/managed.ts.

serial.description: Only ever grows: a remote policy with a lower serial than the one in force, or below remote.minSerial, is refused as a rollback.

settings.description: Settings keys (packages/shared/src/settings.ts) and the values the policy sets; at most 500. Unknown keys, invalid values and values that would loosen a security setting are ignored and reported (unknown_key, invalid_value, loosens, unordered, manual_mode).

remote.description: Read only from the local file (a remote policy cannot point elsewhere): where the signed remote policy is fetched (https only) and the key it must be signed with.

namePattern.description: An exact name or a glob whose * matches any run of characters (screen.*, mcp:corp-*, com.corp.*); matching ignores case.

hostPattern.description: A host name, IPv4 or IPv6 address, or *.domain (the wildcard only as the leftmost label, never a bare * or a whole top-level domain).

folder.description: An absolute path, ~ or a path under ~/ (the Hub user's home); no .. segments.

restrict.description: Each part is optional; an absent part restricts nothing. Unknown parts are refused, so a restriction Nova does not understand fails the whole policy closed.

permissionModes.description: Code session modes and their run and chat equivalents. Manual can never be denied; a refused mode runs as ask_always at the gate.

plugins.description: Plugin ids (an extension is a plugin too).

userAdded.description: false refuses servers the user adds, imports or installs from a bundle.

localStdio.description: false refuses stdio servers the Hub would start itself.

local.description: Code sessions on the Hub's own files.

folders.description: Folders sessions, project folders and tool roots may use (the folder and below).

browserDomains.description: Sites the agent browser may open.

egress.description: The egress ceiling: the mode (the tighter one applies), the hosts allowed (a ceiling over the owner's own network.egressAllow: unset or empty, the policy's hosts apply; otherwise the owner's hosts every policy list covers) and denied (added).

providers.description: Provider kinds models may come from; node is a compute node.

unverifiedInstalls.description: false: plugins, extensions, bundles and marketplace items install only when their signature verifies, and plugins.trustedPublishers is pinned to what the policy sets.

apps.description: false: no third-party app or MCP client may be authorized, and existing app tokens stop working (FR-222, FR-044).

url.description: Fetched over https only (no redirects, 15 s, at most 2 MiB), every refreshMinutes.

publicKey.description: The raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

refreshMinutes.description: How often the Hub fetches it again (default 60).

minSerial.description: The oldest serial the Hub may apply, cached copy included.

remoteEnvelope.description: What remote.url serves: policy is standard base64 of the policy document's bytes (this schema, at most 1 MB); signature is Ed25519 by remote.publicKey over the UTF-8 bytes of "nova-managed-policy-v1\n" + the hex SHA-256 of those bytes, base64url. Mirrors managedEnvelopeSchema in packages/core/src/managed/source.ts.
